products.title: Nox Start Black Ex Js 2026 - Nox

products.title: Drop Shot Revenge Pro - Drop Shot
products.description:
DROP SHOT REVENGE PRO - Versatility, power and control in a mold created by the first Conquerors of magician Juan Lartín Díaz. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

Drop Shot brings us reissues of its most legendary padel rackets, such as this DROP SHOT REVENGE PRO, a racket in offensive format, with great punch and a sweet spot with which to keep up with the pace of the match.

PLAYER TYPE

The DROP SHOT REVENGE PRO is made for advanced or professional level players. Offensive players with good finishing who get the most out of this model.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The features of this DROP SHOT REVENGE PRO make it one of the highest quality Drop Shot paddles. Its format is teardrop, which gives us greater punch and aggressiveness in our blows. However, its balance is spectacular, feeling comfortable and easy to handle.

In its construction, Drop Shot uses 360 curved triaxial carbon on the face of the racket, a premium material in high-end padel rackets that achieves great touch and punch in our shots. Its frame incorporates double carbon tubular for greater durability.

For the core, Drop Shot uses quality high-rebound Eva Soft rubber, which provides optimal precision and ball feel to give everything in our matches and have exceptional control along with a great punch.

The rough touch appears on the faces, which improves the effects of our sliced ​​shots, thanks to the 3D rhomboid-shaped texture, patented by Drop Shot.

It incorporates an anti-vibrator in the heart of the racket, to reduce vibrations to a minimum and a silicone piece that is inserted into the handle of the racket, to improve vibrations even further if possible.

BLADE DESIGN

The DROP SHOT REVENGE PRO opts for a design in striking colors such as red, black and fluorescent yellow for the logo. A sensational choice by Drop Shot.

PLAY STYLE

The recommended playing style of this DROP SHOT REVENGE PRO are those styles with aggressiveness and punch in the blows, but with a good feeling of control.

products.title: Wilson Defy Ls V1 2025 - Wilson
products.description:
WILSON DEFY LS V1 2025 - A good weapon for punchers, lightness, elegant style and aggressive roughness. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The Wilson Defy Ls v1 2025 is a racket with a very outstanding design, with matte gold and black tones. It stands out for its roughness and its weight of 355 grams. 

PLAYER TYPE

This racket is indicated for advanced level players who like to hit the ball and at the same time give it a lot of spin on topspin and slices.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The Defy Ls V1 has a diamond-shaped mold, optimal for a high and fast ball game. Manufactured with different thickness of holes (I-Beam system) facilitating its handling and air passage. Its light weight (355g) and medium-high balance make it a very interesting option for attacking players. The frame is made of carbon, giving it a lot of consistency and its faces are made of CONFORT FLEX Fiberglass, generating high comfort in different hits. Inside we have Power Foam, a compound that exceptionally absorbs the vibration of the impact of the ball, highly recommended for cases of epicondylitis. 

PLAY STYLE

Due to its composition we can affirm that the racket, in addition to being manageable and light, surprises in its response to high balls, vipers and hits. If spin attacks are your thing, don't miss this opportunity, the Defy Ls leaves no one indifferent.

La MYSTICA LEGACY CARBON HYBRID BLUE 2024, es una pala nivel avanzado-profesional, Fabricada con fibra de carbono 100%, concretamente carbono 3K.

TIPO DE JUGADOR

Esta pala Mystica, está ideada para jugadores de nivel avanzado o profesional, que busquen una pala con un formato híbrido, es decir, un formato que aporte control pero muy completa también en ataque.

CARACTERÍSTICAS DE LA PALA

Mystica, es una marca de origen español, la cual intenta acercarse a todo tipo de públicos, de ahí su insistencia en traernos versiones tanto de control, potencia o en este caso una versión híbrida. Este modelo es muy manejable, siendo efectiva en golpes defensivos u ofensivos.

La pala está construida con el carbono 3K un carbono de máxima calidad, resistente y duradero, que junto a sus marcos de carbono nos aseguran una vida útil de la pala estupenda.

Es una pala con balance intermedio, que permite muy buena manejabilidad.

ESTILO DE JUEGO

En la pista, la MYSTICA LEGACY CARBON HYBRID BLUE 2024 es una pala de una calidad increíble. Es difícil que no te guste. El tacto es intermedio, y la salida de bola es muy alta. Es una de esas palas de pádel que te ayudan en defensa y en ataque te permiten atacar y conseguir puntos ganadores sin necesidad de dejarte el brazo en el golpeo.
products.englishTitle: Mystica Legacy Carbon Hybrid Blue 2024 - Mystica
products.englishDescription:
MYSTICA LEGACY CARBON HYBRID BLUE 2024 - The most complete hybrid format in a racket. With reinforcements in the bridge that achieve better stability and reduce vibrations.

 INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The MYSTICA LEGACY CARBON HYBRID BLUE 2024 is an advanced-professional level racket, made with 100% carbon fiber, specifically 3K carbon.

PLAYER TYPE

This Mystica racket is designed for advanced or professional level players who are looking for a racket with a hybrid format, that is, a format that provides control but is also very complete in attack.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

Mystica is a brand of Spanish origin, which tries to reach out to all types of audiences, hence its insistence on bringing us versions of both control, power or in this case a hybrid version. This model is very manageable, being effective in defensive or offensive hits.

The racket is built with 3K carbon, a top quality carbon, resistant and durable, which together with its carbon frames ensures a great useful life of the racket.

It is a padel racket with intermediate balance, which allows very good maneuverability.

PLAY STYLE

products.title: Drop Shot Axion Attack 2024 Jon Sanz - Palas De Padel
products.description:
DROP SHOT AXION ATTACK 2024 JON SANZ - Jon Sanz's new padel racket for 2024 in the Premier Pádel professional padel league. A model that combines great precision, along with fantastic power thanks to its teardrop mold and technologies.

 INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

Drop Shot is one of the leading brands in the padel racket sector. Models like the classic Conqueror have been with us for almost a decade. Today we bring you the DROP SHOT AXION ATTACK 2024 JON SANZ, the new racket that the Premier Padel player Jon Sanz will use, and that seeks maximum power without losing the control that characterizes it.

PLAYER TYPE

The DROP SHOT AXION ATTACK 2024 JON SANZ has been created for advanced or professional level players looking for a versatile padel racket made of great materials.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The new DROP SHOT AXION ATTACK 2024 JON SANZ contains elements that make it stand out as a perfect padel racket for powerful players. It is a racket created in a teardrop format, with a good sweet spot and handling, which facilitates maximum power in the game without loss of control.

In its manufacturing, Drop Shot has used common elements in its padel rackets such as plain carbon and Hotmelt technology to make its frame more resistant and durable, a double tubular of carbon fabrics with maximum durability, which gives it greater rigidity and allows it to not lose power. Textrem Cubicarbon 18K twill technology appears on the interlocking carbon faces, giving the faces flexibility and greater durability for a more comfortable and pleasant touch.

Along with these materials, top-of-the-range technologies appear such as the 3D FACE, in a rhomboidal shape that provides greater spin to the ball when hitting, ideal for aggressive players and sliced ​​shots. The Anti Twist System technology also appears in this model, preventing vibrations, making this DROP SHOT AXION ATTACK 2024 JON SANZ one of the ideal padel rackets for players who want a powerful racket but with good balance.  In the core we find EVA PRO rubber with greater hardness and elasticity, which provides better control and touch of the ball.

It incorporates a protector on the frame of the racket to increase its durability, what the Madrid firm calls Ergo Pro Protector.

BLADE DESIGN

The design of the DROP SHOT AXION ATTACK 2024 JON SANZ has opted for a striking color combination, which changes yellow, silver, black and green.

PLAY STYLE

The new DROP SHOT EXPLORER PRO 3.0 is one of the ideal Drop Shot rackets for advanced or professional players who want an attacking racket, but with good control.
